objective: Move the trusted Avatar/Runtime renderer state, typed IPC orchestration, bounded retry/backoff and polling out of App.vue into one typed composable, leaving App.vue as page composition and top-level lifecycle while preserving every existing control contract.
non_goals: Do not change the VRM/Live2D renderer, widget drag or persistence behavior, avatar state machine, Safety policy, control-plane routes, IPC contract, polling intervals or retry timings.

Do not add a dependency, direct Electron/Node/network/storage/process access, new model, new asset, auto-listener, arbitrary command surface or real desktop/model/Cloud/VTube Studio/Spout/microphone/TTS smoke against the owner's active session.
Do not move page presentation back into App.vue or grant page components a raw IPC/capability handle.
contracts: useAvatarRuntime is the sole renderer composable owner of Avatar/Widget/VRM state and the Runtime & Safety mute/emergency workflow: fixed typed IPC calls, 250 ms avatar polling, one-second Safety/widget polling, bounded offline backoff and VRM renderer event handling. Perception's separate feature-flag control remains in its existing App-level workflow.
App.vue retains operator/window lifecycle, top-level page selection, global error banner composition and cleanup composition, but no longer implements Avatar/Runtime control logic inline.

The composable may call only the existing named window.hinaDesktop methods. It imports no Electron, Node, direct network API, persistence, process access, model runtime or arbitrary command mechanism.
AvatarPage and RuntimePage remain presentation-only, receive bounded values and emit only fixed intent/event payloads; they never import the composable or window.hinaDesktop directly.
Tests cover the migrated composable as part of the trusted renderer surface and retain the no-direct-capability plus lazy-VRM/widget/Safety contract checks.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed preload API and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: App.vue composes useAvatarRuntime instead of owning Avatar/Runtime state, IPC handlers, polling/backoff and VRM recovery functions inline.
Avatar/Runtime pages keep the same typed props/emits and all fixed controls retain their existing behavior and disabled states.
The dashboard architecture documentation describes the composable as the trusted renderer boundary beneath App.vue/pages.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
